# cubepath_transcoder_job (Data Source)

Reads a Video Transcoder job: status, progress and the files it produced. Jobs are submitted with the API, the CLI or the SDKs; Terraform only reads them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the job.

### Read-Only

- `batch_id` (String) Batch the job was submitted in, if any.
- `completed_segments` (Number) Segments already encoded.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `error` (String) Error of a failed job.
- `input_url` (String) Input URL, for jobs read from a URL.
- `output_bucket` (String) Destination bucket.
- `output_path` (String) Destination prefix in the bucket.
- `outputs` (Attributes List) Files produced by a finished job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outputs))
- `progress` (Number) Progress, 0 to 100.
- `status` (String) queued, analyzing, encoding, finalizing, completed, failed or canceled.
- `total_segments` (Number) Segments the video was split into.

<a id="nestedatt--outputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outputs`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Bucket.
- `key` (String) Object key.
- `type` (String) Output type: file, hls, thumbnails or gif.
